messages.subject: Help with controlling selectInput
parts:
Hi all,

I have a selectInput control, and I'm trying to add "Previous" and "Next" buttons to the UI that would allow users to cycle through the 122 choices one-by-one... The following code seems to accomplish this functionality, but it's a little bit touchy---like if I push the "Previous" button a few times really quickly, it will start oscillating back and forth between a few different choices and becomes unresponsive. Is there a better way to code this?

Also, I'd like for the app to select a random choice to show on start-up. Right now, when the app loads, it shows choice "121" every time, and I can't figure out why.

Anyway, the relevant portion of the code looks like this:

ui.R:
  sidebarPanel(
    uiOutput("dropdown"),
    actionButton("dec", label="Previous"),
    actionButton("inc", label="Next")
  )

server.R:
x <- 1:122
names(x) <- as.character(x)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  ### REACTIVE VALUES ###
  values <- reactiveValues(q.num=sample.int(122, size=1))
  
  ### QUESTION SELECTION ###
  # Drop-down
  observe({
    input$q.select
    isolate(values$q.num <- as.numeric(input$q.select))
  })  
  # Increment
  observe({
    input$inc
    isolate(values$q.num <- min(122, values$q.num + 1))
  })
  # Decrement
  observe({
    input$dec
    isolate(values$q.num <- max(1, values$q.num - 1))
  })
  # UI Output
  output$dropdown <- renderUI({
    selectInput("q.select", label="Number:", choices=x,
                selected=names(x)[values$q.num])
  })
})

Thoughts?

-- Josh
